snippet.title: MECCHA CHAMELEON – Nintendo Direct 9.9.2026
snippet.description:
MECCHA CHAMELEON is available today on Nintendo Switch 2: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/meccha-chameleon-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

MECCHA CHAMELEON is a competitive hide-and-seek game featuring a unique drawing mechanic. The hiding team blends into their surroundings by painting their bodies with nearby colors and patterns, while carefully posing to mimic walls, furniture, or decor. Meanwhile, the “It” team searches for suspicious spots to expose the hiders. If the “It” team finds everyone before time runs out, they win! But if even one hider survives, the hiding team claims victory. Whether you get spotted despite flawless camouflage or surprisingly escape notice with a bold trick, every match is full of laughs. Your creative inspiration decides the outcome!

#NintendoDirect #MECCHACHAMELEON
